newsitem.title: TANZANIA: South Africa trade delegation arrives in Tanzania.
newsitem.headline: South Africa trade delegation arrives in Tanzania.

text.p: A South African delegation has arrived in Tanzania to expand trade links, embassy officials said on Saturday.
The 57-member mission, South Africa's biggest to Tanzania, arrived on Friday and will host a two-day seminar in the capital from July 20.

"The main objective of the mission is to encourage economic relations between the South African and Tanzania private sectors by identifying possibilities for expanding bilateral trade and joint venture opportunities," said an embassy statement.

South African companies hoping to strike a deal include firms specialising in engineering, agricultural machinery, cosmetics, household goods, office furniture, packaging and canning, communications, financial services and road transport.
South African investment is already key to the impoverished East African nation, with firms active in the mining, construction and consumer goods sectors.
